title: Topic 2
japanese_text:
A：新しい恋人はどう？
B：優しい人だよ。連絡も<u>まめ</u>できれい好きだし。
A：それはポイント高いね。
B：でも、きれい好きすぎてさ…。部屋に<u>ちり</u>一つ落ちてるのも嫌みたい。私は掃除とか<u>雑な</u>方だから。
english_translation: A: How's your new partner? B: Great, actually. Easygoing, diligent about keeping in touch, and likes everything clean. A: That's great. B: But there's such a thing as too clean. Even a speck of dust in the room is too much, apparently. When it comes to cleaning, I'm a little more careless.
